name: Glasgow Autumn - Scottish Blind Off 2024

venue.name: Learning and Teaching Building, Strathclyde University

information: This is a blind events specialist events competition, so we do not recommend this competition to first time competitors. If you are a first time competitor or beginner, please check out [Glasgow 3x3 Evening 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Glasgow3x3Evening2024) on Wednesday 9th instead.
